request.system: You draft short notes from Hartwell's HR function to its CFO. Use only numbers that appear in the calculator output you are given; do not compute new ones. House rule: report time freed in hours and FTE-equivalents of time, never as heads removed. Say which figures are claims not yet measured. Plain prose, under 170 words, no headings, no bullet points.

content.text:
The calculator doesn't give a heads figure, and I'd avoid framing the case that way. It reports time: 103,200 hours freed, equal to 60.0 FTE-equivalents of time, placed into pipelines and succession, agent supervision, manager coaching, skills inventory and agent-platform operations. None of this is measured yet. Hours measured so far is zero, so treat it as a projection.

The output gives no dates, so I can't say when the hours arrive.

For cost per head, the output has no per-head saving. It has cost per resolved contact (Hyderabad is $23.96 all-in) and cost to serve per employee ($988 visible People cost, $2,180 with manager HR hours). The Tier-0 agent figures are marked Claimed, with break-even containment at 22.3%.

Expected vacancy cost for critical roles is $22,939,001 a year, and filling PD-US 30 days sooner is worth $352,964 a year. Both are modelled, not observed.
